description: Play-only timeline sequencer: plays up to 25 named songs of ten tracks of clips, built in Entrian Timeline and saved for the free plugin

params.text: Returns the playhead to the beginning, or to the start repeat marker with that option set on the menu

inputs.text: The clock that drives playback, at four ticks per beat, which a clock module calls x4 or 1/16th
Chooses which of the 25 songs plays, C3 selecting the first and the 25 semitones up to C5 the last; set to trigger on the menu it steps to the next non-empty song or picks one at random
A trigger returning the playhead to the beginning, or to the start repeat marker with that option set on the menu; playback carries on immediately if the sequencer is running
A trigger toggling between running and stopped; while stopped the gates are closed and clock ticks are ignored

outputs.text: Carries 1V/oct pitch where that track holds a melody clip, the segment voltage where it holds a CV clip, and a trigger where it holds a drum clip
A gate held open for the length of each note on that track, or a trigger on each accented note where the track holds a drum clip
The velocity of the note being played on that track
Carries a reset out of the sequencer each time its Reset button is pressed, on the panel or in the editor window, so a clock module can be reset from here
Carries the Run button out of the sequencer, pressed on the panel or in the editor window, so a clock module can be started and stopped from here

notes: the large display draws the sequence with the playhead as a vertical line, and clicking it opens a window showing the notes; they cannot be edited here, though a MIDI file can be imported
the module is empty when it is added. It plays a patch saved out of Entrian Sequencers, or a MIDI file imported into the editor window, and until one of those arrives there is nothing to play
clicking the large display opens an editor window showing the notes. They cannot be recorded here, but a MIDI file can be imported into that window or dropped onto it
the playhead and the start and end repeat markers are drawn on the large display and can be moved by clicking and dragging there, without opening the editor window
the small display names the song now playing, and clicking it lists the 25 songs to choose from
the Song CV/menu control in the editor window, not the panel menu, sets when a change of song takes effect: Instant at once, or End of phrase at the end of the current one
menu: Song selection input: — how the song input is read: Pitch, C3-C5; Trigger next non-empty song; Trigger random song (random but fair); or Trigger random song (truly random)
Shared playhead: — Don't share the playhead, Shared playhead leader or Shared playhead follower, which moves the playheads of all the linked Entrian sequencers together
Delay Clock/Reset/Run inputs — delays those three inputs by a whole number of samples, to offset the one-sample delay every Rack cable adds; Auto is the default and None the other choice
Set playhead to start marker on reset — a reset sends the playhead to the start repeat marker instead of to the beginning
Save patch to use Entrian Sequencers... — writes the patch out again with each Player module swapped for the Entrian Sequencers module it came from
